{{Top|leg}}
'''''Toone''''' was a pair of [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They were present trying to deliver pilots to Rebel starfighters as their base fell under attack by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']]. The tugs were both destroyed, along with the rest of the Rebels.
